'''Kolkar Crag'''{{co|48|78|Durotar}} was a craggy gorge in southern [[Durotar]] called this way because of the [[Kolkar clan|Kolkar]] [[centaur]]s inhabiting it.

==History==
Three years after the [[Battle of Mount Hyjal]], when [[Theramore Isle|Theramore]] received words that [[orc]] troops were massing at Kolkar Crag, they sent reinforcements to [[Northwatch Hold]].<ref>''[[Cycle of Hatred]]'', chapter 13</ref>

The Kolkar plotted to launch an attack on the towns of Durotar: The [[Valley of Trials]], [[Sen'jin Village]], [[Razor Hill]], and even the gates of [[Orgrimmar]].<ref>[[Thwarting Kolkar Aggression]]</ref> The Kolkar here were led by [[Warlord Kolkanis]].
